name: PAP (De Particulier à Particulier)
positioning: The private-to-private marketplace — no agencies, by design, since long before the internet.
description: PAP publishes only listings from private individuals, excluding real estate professionals as a matter of editorial policy. It provides sellers and landlords with listing tools, document templates and guidance for handling a transaction or a tenancy without an agency.
real_estate_use: Two opposite uses. For an owner it is the reference channel for selling or letting without paying agency fees, with the legal templates that decision requires. For an agency it is a pure pige source: every listing on PAP is by definition an owner who has chosen not to use a professional, which makes it the hardest and most valuable canvassing ground in France.
features: Lease, notice and transaction document templates
Guidance content on selling and letting without an agency

use_cases.job: Sell or let a property without agency fees, with the paperwork provided
Canvass owners who have explicitly chosen to go without an agency
